sources.title: Agricultural land: assess proposals for development
sources.facts: Sets considerations for development proposals and use of Agricultural Land Classification.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove exact grade or planning acceptability.

sources.title: Guide to assessing development proposals on agricultural land
sources.facts: Explains surveys, soil pits and evidence for best and most versatile agricultural land.
sources.guard: Desktop evidence cannot replace a suitable detailed site survey where required.

sources.title: Natural environment planning guidance
sources.facts: Explains Agricultural Land Classification, statutory consultation and soil protection.
sources.guard: Planning guidance does not determine exact soil quality or consent.

sources.title: The Land Use Framework for England
sources.facts: Sets strategic land-use principles and references updated predictive ALC mapping.
sources.guard: A strategic framework does not decide individual sites or landowner actions.

sources.title: Predictive Agricultural Land Classification Map for England
sources.facts: Provides a strategic-scale predictive ALC map including subdivision of grade 3.
sources.guard: Predictive mapping is not a detailed parcel survey and carries scale limitations.

sources.title: Agricultural land classification dataset
sources.facts: Publishes standardised ALC data with Natural England attribution.
sources.guard: Standardised data does not prove current field condition or exact subgrade.

sources.title: Construction Code of Practice for the Sustainable Use of Soils on Construction Sites
sources.facts: Provides practical guidance for stripping, storing, handling and reusing soil during construction.
sources.guard: A code of practice does not prove compliance or restoration quality.

sources.title: How to comply with the Farming Rules for Water
sources.facts: Explains nutrient planning, soil testing and reasonable precautions against erosion and pollution.
sources.guard: Rules do not prove a holding is compliant or a development is acceptable.
